{{Quote|I am the one and only Darth Hexid: tormentor of the weak and bane of all who challenge me.|Darth Hexid|<ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=message|Dark Council?|Darth Hexid}}</ref>}}
'''Darth Hexid''' was a [[Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Order (disambiguation)|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. She was a connoisseur of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Renowned for her brutal combat prowess and decadent lifestyle, she enjoyed the many pleasures of a celebrated Sith, whether savoring exotic feasts held in her honor or hunting down her foes as they fled in a panic. Instead of joining the political infighting of her Sith peers, she amused herself by watching their rabid power games from the sidelines.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref> Darth Hexid earned infamy following her devastating triumphs in the [[Great Galactic War]], but it was the Sith Order's crushing defeat at the hands of [[Zakuul]]'s conquering army that forever defined her. She then pursued the complete annihilation of the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
When the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Attack on Korriban|invaded]] the [[Sith Order (disambiguation)|Sith]] holy world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Darth Hexid was among the Sith present to defend the planet. She carved through multiple [[Knights of Zakuul]] before an explosion drove her unconscious. Upon waking up she found Korriban ravaged by [[Prince/Legends|Princes]] [[Arcann]] and [[Thexan]], [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|the Academy]] crippled by the event. When the Eternal Empire became the dominant power in the galaxy, Darth Hexid grew to despise the [[Dark Council]], seeing the group as dogs aiming towards destroying each other after the death and disappearance of [[Darth Marr]] and [[Darth Nox]] respectively.

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Hexid debuted as a companion in the [[2016]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]]. She was only available to players who achieved at least the "Eternal" tier during the "Dark vs. Light" event in summer 2016.<ref name="LvD">{{TORweb|url=blog/dark-vs.-light-event-and-rewards-blog|text=Dark vs. Light Event and Rewards Blog}}</ref> 

She has since been made made unlockable for all players by completing three PVE or PVP missions before November 27th, 2017, as part of the United Forces update.<ref name="TORweb-United Forces Update Coming this November">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20171002|text=United Forces Update Coming this November}}</ref> After update 5.9 Darth Hexid can be obtained after completing 40 group finder activities.<ref name="TOR:WaLHfmF">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=other|Achievement: "With a Little Help from My Friends"}}</ref>

===Gameplay alternatives===
If the player completes the 5.10 story on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] as an ally to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the player will receive a mail from Hexid expressing her interest on the [[Dark Council]]'s vacant seat.<ref name="Mail" />
